explanation: Strings are immutable; += creates a new string object, leaving x unchanged.
Array elements of value types are initialized to their default value (0 for int).
!true is false; false && false is false; false || true is true.
The evaluation order of x++ and ++x is unspecified; different compilers may produce different results.
The null-conditional operator ?. returns null if s is null, then ?? replaces it with 0.
ToString() returns a String object, and GetType().Name on a string returns "String".
Structs are value types; new Point() initializes all fields to default values (X = 0).
Casting a char to int returns its Unicode/ASCII value; 'A' is 65.
decimal * int promotes int to decimal; result is 31.5m, printed as "31.5".
